events.title: The Lantern Bobbin Ferry
events.description: A bobbin boat rocks beneath hanging lanterns, its ragdoll ferryman winding loose thread in the amber hush.

choices.text: Pay the ferryman 12 gold for loose thread (+2 scraps)
Trade a thread bundle for parcel wages (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Walk along the bank (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Thimble Star Reading
events.description: A felt fortune-reader peers through a silver thimble at stitched constellations, their frame trailing pale starlint.

choices.text: Sell a spool to the reader (spend 1 scrap; gain 16 gold)
Collect thread caught in the frame (+1 scrap)
Pass by (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Moonpatch Archway
events.description: Tiny cloth patches line a crescent arch; dangling price tags whisper against its candlelit seams.

choices.text: Purchase two spools (spend 15 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Sell two spools (spend 2 scraps; gain 27 gold)
Keep walking (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Blacklace Swap Table
events.description: Small button-eyed puppets barter ribbons over an ink-black lace tablecloth, their stitched smiles lit by candle stubs.

choices.text: Buy a small ribbon bundle (spend 8 gold; gain 1 scrap)
Sell your own bundle (spend 1 scrap; gain 14 gold)
Decline the trade (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Crooked Marionette
events.description: A wooden puppet dangles crookedly above a candle, offering a little coin purse for rethreading its frayed strings.

choices.text: Rethread the puppet's strings (spend 2 scraps; earn 30 gold)
Gather discarded thread cuttings (+1 scrap)
Leave the puppet (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Dusk Post Bobbin
events.description: A patchwork postbox totters on a walking spindle, accepting thread-wrapped letters through a softly glowing slot.

choices.text: Pay postage and receive spare wrapping thread (spend 10 gold; gain 1 scrap)
Wrap letters for delivery wages (spend 1 scrap; earn 17 gold)
Pass the postbox (no cost or gain)

events.title: The Bellglass Night Market
events.description: Round button-eyed merchants count glass bells beneath plum awnings, every bobbin lit by a single amber lantern.

choices.text: Pay 26 gold for three bundles of midnight thread (+3 scraps)
Trade three scrap bundles for 39 gold
Leave the bellglass traders to their counting

events.title: The Crowlace Ticket Booth
events.description: A stuffed crow in a gold-button waistcoat stamps crooked ferry tickets beside a black-lace window.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold for a pair of thread tickets (+2 scraps)
Exchange one spare scrap bundle for 15 gold
Let the paper tickets flutter away

events.title: The Moonlit Pin Exchange
events.description: A slate-blue puppet clerk opens a pin-lined drawer beneath a stitched button moon.

choices.text: Pay 34 gold for five rolled pin bundles (+5 scraps)
Turn two scrap bundles into 33 gold
Close the pin drawer without trading

events.title: The Oxblood Patch Hall
events.description: Tiny velvet ragdolls hold a candlelit auction around an oxblood quilt sewn with brass-button seals.

choices.text: Spend 23 gold on three fine repair seams (+3 scraps)
Auction four scrap bundles for 51 gold
Bow out before the next auction bell

events.title: The Bone-Cream Button Press
events.description: A squat stitched machinist works a giant button press under cream damask curtains.

choices.text: Buy a mould offcut for 12 gold (+1 scrap)
Pawn two scrap bundles for 22 gold
Let the press fall silent

events.title: The Saffron Spool Trial
events.description: A plump saffron-robed spool-keeper displays prize threads in a midnight-teal candlelit alcove.

choices.text: Pay 40 gold for five prize-thread bundles (+5 scraps)
Sell two scrap bundles for 31 gold
Decline the spool-keeper’s trial

events.title: The Lost-Sleeve Signalbox
events.description: A slate-blue signal hut balances on quilted stilts; three plump glove puppets pull enormous brass levers with their loose sleeves while one candle lights the switchboard.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold for two bundles of spare signal-thread (+2 scraps)
Trade two scrap bundles for 24 gold in repair wages
Leave the glove keepers to their switches

events.title: The Mourning Quiltwheel
events.description: An old fairground wheel turns with stuffed mitten-shaped carriages; bone-cream pennants hang over an empty velvet square and a button-eyed keeper oils its stitches.

choices.text: Pay 27 gold for three bundles of wheel-mending thread (+3 scraps)
Give one scrap bundle to the keeper for 16 gold
Let the quiltwheel creak through another turn

events.title: The Hollow-Glove Observatory
events.description: A gigantic stuffed glove points at a midnight-plum sky from a stitched rooftop; its four button fingertips hold silver thread across a brass star chart.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold for one spool of star-chart cord (+1 scrap)
Sell three scrap bundles for 31 gold
Fold the star chart and follow the dark road

events.title: The Inkglass Needle Laundry
events.description: Under black glass gutters, a round doll laundress hangs patched sleeves between two towering silver sewing needles; candlelit droplets bead on the thread lines.

choices.text: Pay 32 gold for four clean repair-thread bundles (+4 scraps)
Trade two scrap bundles for 23 gold in laundry wages
Leave the sleeves drying under the gutter lamp
